questions.prompt: Which gives all real solutions of 2sin x - 1 = 0?
questions.prompt_markup: Which gives all real solutions of 2sin x - 1 = 0?

choices.text: x = π/3 + 2kπ or x = 2π/3 + 2kπ, k an integer
x = π/6 + kπ, k an integer

questions.prompt: Why are identities useful for solving equations that contain different trigonometric functions?
questions.prompt_markup: Why are identities useful for solving equations that contain different trigonometric functions?

choices.text: They rewrite the equation in one function (or let it factor), so inverse functions can be applied.
They turn every equation into a linear equation that has exactly one solution.
They remove the need to check the solutions in the original equation.
They change the period of each function to 2π, so the graphs match.

questions.correct_answer: They rewrite the equation in one function (or let it factor), so inverse functions can be applied.
questions.grading_note: For example sin 2x = sin x becomes sin x(2cos x - 1) = 0. The others are false: identities do not make equations linear, do not remove the need to check, and do not change periods.
